name: Anime Frontier
blurb: North Texas's December anime convention at the Fort Worth Convention Center, with voice-actor guests and cosplay.

picks: Ellie in The Last of Us
English dub director of One Piece

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'ANIME IS BIGGER IN TEXAS - FORT WORTH - DEC. 4-6, 2026' and 'WHERE FORT WORTH CONVENTION CENTER 1201 Houston St, Fort Worth, TX 76102'.

notes: animefrontier.com returns a Cloudflare bot-check ('Just a moment...') to the renderer on both the default and msedge channels, so the homepage and guests page were read from Wayback Machine snapshots of those same official URLs (Sept/Oct 2026 captures) instead of a live render; url/tickets/guestsPage above are still the live site's own addresses. Organizer confirmed via the page's own footer credit ('Anime Frontier is a creation of LeftField Media, the creators of Anime NYC'). Skipped non-guest candidates: #0-1 (site logos), #2 (a 'GUESTS' section-header card, not a person), #29 (the LeftField Media footer credit banner), #30-54 (hidden duplicate modal cards for the same 26 guests already picked from their thumbnails, #3-28, used only to read fuller bios), and #55 (an untitled full-width image with no guest text). Several bios were truncated by the page's own 'read more' cutoff before naming a specific role, so known-for is left blank or generic for Corey Pettit, Rudy Lopez and Sarah Wiedenheft rather than guessing which anime they voice; Corey Pettit's cat is inferred as voice from the surrounding section (every other name in that 'GUESTS' group is an explicitly stated voice actor) rather than from her own bio text, which cuts off before stating her craft.
